notes.title: Devlog - Episode 6
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to Ketz: Galactic Overlords Devlog Episode 6[/b]

In this devlog, we’re unveiling new systems and design philosophies that continue to evolve the Ketz experience. From strategic challenge mechanics to smarter enemies and a sneak peek at our next playable hero. This dev sets the stage for even deeper gameplay customization and variety.

[h2]The Reimagined Challenge Box (Future Updates)[/h2]

We’re thrilled to announce we are redesigning the Challenge Box system.

What was once a linear difficulty selector is now a living system; built around progression, experimentation, and player-driven decision making.

At its core, the new Challenge Box will be a [b]point-based structure.[/b]Throughout your runs, you’ll complete specific objectives and earn [b]Challenge Points.[/b] These points are your key to unlocking harder challenges in your next run.

The system is laid out as a [b]challenge tree[/b], branching into three distinct challenge categories:

[list]
[*] [b]Empowered Enemies:[/b] Enemies gain more health, hit harder, spawn in larger waves, and bosses become significantly more dangerous.
[*][b] Player Debuffs: [/b]Your base stats like max health, attack speed, or movement speed are reduced, demanding new survival strategies.
[*] [b]Resource Limiters:[/b] Potions heal less, health pickups restore fewer points, and resource gain across the run becomes limited.
[/list]

As you explore each branch, you’ll activate nodes. Some increase item drop rates, while others provide small but powerful buffs.

The new Challenge Box is about more than just difficulty; it’s about risk, mastery, and growth. And it will evolve as you do.

[h2]Evolving Enemies of the New Chapter[/h2]

With the arrival of our next chapter, enemy behavior is stepping up to the next level.

We’re moving beyond raw stat upgrades. Now, enemies don’t just hit harder; they behave differently.

Every enemy type is gaining new behavioral diversity through [b]enhanced M2[/b] variants.
Let’s break it down:

[list]
[*] [b]A basic melee[/b] enemy may only strike you in its original form. But its M2 variant? It explodes on death, leaving behind a [b]toxic cloud[/b] that punishes careless movement.
[*][b] A ranged attacker[/b] normally shoots projectiles. Its M2 version? Those same projectiles now [b]grant shields to nearby allies[/b] upon contact, turning a damage-dealer into an unexpected support unit.
[/list]

This level of behavioral depth turns familiar encounters into moments of surprise; even for veteran players. You’ll never be quite sure what an upgraded enemy might do, and that’s exactly the point.

Even[b] bosses[/b] are changing. Through the Challenge Box, certain challenge nodes now [b]modify boss behavior[/b], increasing the frequency or complexity of their special abilities.

This feature isn’t just about making enemies tougher; it’s about making them unpredictable, dynamic, and truly exciting to fight.

[h2]A Glimpse of What’s Coming: New Character Sneak Peek (Future Updates)[/h2]

A new hero is in development, and while we’re keeping most details under wraps for now, we couldn’t resist teasing what’s to come.

This upcoming hero will be the[b] sixth playable character[/b] in Ketz; bringing an entirely new rhythm and role to combat.

Unlike our existing five characters, this one[b] fights at mid-range[/b], wielding a[b] whip-based weapon[/b] designed to control space and string together graceful, deadly combos.

Their skill set bridges the gap between melee and ranged; offering unique mechanics for crowd control, zone denial, and high-tempo movement.

We’ll be revealing more art, animation, and gameplay in the near future. For now, consider this your first taste of something... a little snappier.



All of the systems and features shown in [b]this devlog[/b] are designed to give players more choice, more surprises, and more ways to play. Whether you’re here for strategic depth, fresh combat dynamics, or new heroes to master; Ketz is growing in every direction.

[u]Thanks again for being on this journey with us.[/u]

[b]NOTE:[/b] The Challenge Box and new character planning for later updates which following the Chapter 2 update. For now, we are focusing on testing and improving Chapter 2.


[b]— The Ketz: Galactic Overlords Team[/b]

notes.title: Version 0.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]First of All, Thank You![/b]
Thank you once again for all the feedback and bug reports you've shared with us throughout the Early Access period.Every message you send helps us shape the Ketz universe into a more balanced, stable, and enjoyable experience.

With this patch, we’re introducing several key systems that push gameplay variety, item depth, and customization even further.

Below are all the additions and fixes included in version [u]0.0.7:[/u]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new Level of Detail [b](LOD)[/b] menu has been added to the graphic settings. You can now adjust texture and detail quality to better match your system’s performance needs.
[*] Every run now offers a more unpredictable and diverse combat experience. Enemy types will vary each second, ensuring no two runs feel the same.
For details: See Devlog Episode 5 – [b]“Dynamic Wave System: No Run Is Ever the Same”[/b]
[*] [b]Loot is no longer static[/b]. Even if you pick up the same item twice, its stats can now vary significantly.
For example: Two Astral Trailblazer Boots might give completely different bonuses; one may offer Dash Cooldown + Luck, while the other only boosts Pick-Up Range.
Some items can even surpass higher-tier gear depending on their rolled stats.
[b](Note: All existing items in your inventory have been re-rolled and updated to match this new system.)[/b]
[*] All items now generate an [b]Item Power[/b] value based on the strength of their rolled stats.
IP determines the true value of an item; making it possible for a Rare item (e.g., 205 IP) to outclass an Epic item (e.g., 200 IP). This system rewards attention to detail and encourages evaluating gear beyond just rarity.
[/list]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lyria’s exclusive gear can now roll with Attack Speed as part of the new stat system.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Legendary and Unique filters in the Item Filter menu now behave correctly. Previously, they were activating by default and sometimes blocking item pickups.
[*] Issues occurring during the recrafting process with Orin Vaal have been resolved.
[*] Fixed a bug where entering Bombider’s explosion radius would instantly deal damage. Hitbox logic has been improved for more accurate interaction.
[*] Resolved a bug where Knockback Technology was incorrectly applying knockback to all skills instead of only basic attacks.
[/list]


We’ll continue bringing new content, performance improvements, and balance updates throughout the Early Access period.

We care about your feedback and experiences and we continue to improve Ketz accordingly.

Thank you,
[b]The Ketz: Galactic Overlords Team[/b]

notes.title: Devlog - Episode 5
notes.content:
Welcome to Ketz: Galactic Overlords Devlog Episode 5

In this devlog, we're taking a closer look at systems that will shape the future of Ketz; from how you build your hero to how enemies adapt to your strength.

[h2]1. A New World, New Gear to Discover[/h2]

 We’re starting with the foundation of every run: [b]loot[/b].

[b]New Item System: Dynamic Item Stats, Stronger Loot[/b]

A brand-new item system is being developed to make every drop feel impactful.
 Items from Common to Legendary now roll stats based on their rarity, with improved variety and depth.
[u]How It Works:[/u]
[list]
[*] Items can come with inherent stats that are automatically assigned and scale with rarity.
[*] Then, prefixes are rolled from a dedicated stat pool.
[*] Suffixes are added afterward, with their count calculated as:
     Suffix = Total Mod Slots - Prefix Count
[*] Inherent stats don’t count toward total mod limits.
[/list]
Higher rarities roll more powerful and complex stat combinations, making item discovery a more meaningful part of every run.

[b]Unique Items[/b]
Unique items follow their own rules; they are handcrafted; always fixed; always distinct.
They cannot be found in alternate versions and stand apart from the stat roll system.
[b]Item Power (IP)[/b]
All items are now evaluated with an Item Power value, calculated based on the total quality of their stats and scaled by rarity.
This score directly affects the item’s value, pricing, and impact.
[b]What’s Next?[/b]
This system lays the groundwork for deeper item crafting and better loot pacing.
You’ll soon be able to plan builds around what you find; or what you choose to forge.

[h2]2. Dynamic Wave System: No Run Is Ever the Same[/h2]
We're moving away from fixed wave patterns.
 From now on, each run will offer a different combat flow; even if you're playing the same character, on the same map.
Only boss encounter times are fixed.
 Other than that, every minute from 1 to 19 now pulls from a pool of alternative wave sets.
Each wave stage has several possible variants, and the system randomly selects which one will spawn based on weighted chances.
[b]This means:[/b]
[list]
[*] You might face more enemies at the same timestamp in one run...
[*] Or fight a completely different enemy type in another.
[*] Some waves may feel more intense, while others open up breathing room.
[*] It's all part of making every run feel fresh, adaptive, and full of unexpected moments.
[/list]

[h2]3. A Glimpse Into the Next Chapter[/h2]
The biggest part of this devlog and of our current development efforts; is the upcoming new chapter.
 We're deep in internal testing right now, and we expect to release this major update sometime between [b]July 4 and 11.[/b]
Here’s a quick look at what this next chapter will bring:
[list]
[*] A brand-new forest-themed map
[*] 3 entirely new bosses to challenge your builds
[*] Completely new enemy types, including “Vol.2” versions of existing enemies with reworked behaviors
[*] New Tier 2 item sets for deeper gear progression
[*] 12 new monuments to discover
[*] And a fresh set of new challenges to push your limits
[/list]
We’re also sharing a small preview GIF from Chapter 2  just a hint of what’s to come.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/d9e4c643e48101602e6dffb7d5cde8b2374cd01b.gif[/img]

All of the systems you've seen in this devlog; from the new item structure to the wave logic and upcoming content, are being shaped based on your feedback and our long term vision for Ketz.

We’ll continue to share development insights, systems, and upcoming content through future devlogs; and you’ll see many of these features roll out in upcoming updates.
Thanks for joining us on this journey and we’ll see you in the next run.

[b]— The Ketz: Galactic Overlords Team[/b]

notes.title: Devlog - Episode 4
notes.content:
[h2]A New Step with Redesigned UI[/h2]
With the launch of Early Access, we’ve taken a fresh look at the visual language behind the systems of Ketz: Galactic Overlords.
All core user interface elements that support gameplay have been redesigned with a focus on clarity, consistency, and usability.
In this developer diary, we’re sharing just a small portion of the comprehensive changes we’ve made.

[h3]Mystimech Selection Screen[/h3]
The Mystimech selection screen, the core of our ability system; is now more readable, structured, and intuitive.
Tier structure, visual separation, and description panels have been reworked to help players make better decisions with ease.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/a40f6ad62f492b697d39ff4ee434f5aa7c1f99af.png[/img]

[h3]Inventory and Shop[/h3]
Item frames, rarity colors, and equipment categories have all been updated.
The panel layout has been simplified to make it easier to understand where each item belongs and what effects it provides.
The shop interface has also been redesigned following the same principles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/23b0fb2544d5cbc0e7b8c8ea05d316b7f0008de1.jpg[/img]

Together with these examples, all in-game panels are being redesigned.
These systems are being developed with a focus on visual clarity, content density, and fast decision-making; and will be delivered to players in upcoming updates.
What you've seen in this devlog is only a small glimpse of the new interface; the full redesign will be live with the next update.

[h3]Graphics Performance and LOD System Updates[/h3]
To improve in-game performance and better support a variety of hardware configurations, we’ve implemented a new Level of Detail (LOD) system along with graphics quality settings.

Players can now choose between four visual presets: Ultra, High, Medium, and Low.

One of the key optimizations was made in the shadow system. Previously, shadows were rendered using ultra-quality meshes. Now, they’re rendered with low-poly meshes that maintain the same visual quality, resulting in significantly better performance.

Additionally, shaders used by enemies have been optimized.
We fixed logic issues within the shaders and eliminated unnecessary rendering operations, leading to smoother overall performance.
These improvements will be included in upcoming updates.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/69f29666d1c9183e5071d4707436211646fc14b9.png[/img]

We're actively expanding the game’s content and continuing to improve Ketz based on player feedback.

See you in the next devlog; we’ll continue sharing this journey with you through regular updates.

[h3]Preview from the Next Devlog[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/45b43d63ecc4e2797b22adc75cd109e4dd2abb57.jpg[/img]

[b]The Ketz: Galactic Overlords Team[/b]

notes.title: Devlog - Episode 3
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]Welcome to the third episode in the Ketz: Galactic Overlords Developer Log.[/b]

In this edition, we will share upcoming game systems, characters, and mechanics with you, providing more insight into the development process. We also aim to shape the game’s progression together with feedback from the community.

Today, we will introduce Kael, the master tracker and archer shaped by the wilds of Arden. Let’s dive into her story and combat mechanics.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/69c67b1c32586749d5add3a9cd4b9c55901b51b1.png[/img]
[h3]Meet Kael – Master Hunter of Arden[/h3]
Kael hails from Arden, an untamed world filled with dense forests and fierce wildlife. Trained from childhood to survive and hunt in the most unforgiving terrain, she became a legendary tracker, moving with unmatched stealth and striking with deadly accuracy.

But Kael’s peaceful world changed when unnatural creatures began creeping into the edges of Arden’s woodlands. Her instincts warned her that something far greater was unfolding. As she tracked these intruders, she uncovered a grim truth—Ketzeror’s corruption had reached her homeworld.

With Arden’s future hanging in the balance, Kael set off alone, determined to trace the threat back to its source. Her journey eventually led her to The Sanctuary, where she encountered Rax. Impressed by her skills and unwavering resolve, Rax welcomed her as a part of The Sanctuary.


[h3]Kael’s Combat Style[/h3]

Kael wields a high-powered bow, relying on agility and precision to strike from afar. Her combat is defined by two core mechanics:

[list]
[*] [b]Piercing Arrows:[/b] Kael’s arrows pierce through enemies, continuing past the initial target and damaging others in their path.
[*] [b]Focused Volley:[/b] Every third attack, Kael fires two attack instead of one.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/5ecadd535d4e825583341c494c137e5a336340d1.png[/img]

[h3]How Will You Harness Kael’s Hunter’s Instinct?[/h3]

Kael will be playable in [b]Early Access.[/b]
[list]
[*] What do you think of her double-shot mechanic?
[*] Which ability combos do you think would best amplify her power?
[/list]
Share your thoughts with us!

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Ketz/[/b]

More exciting updates coming in the next devlog! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog - Episode 2
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]Welcome to the second episode of the Ketz: Galactic Overlords developer log.[/b]

In this edition, we will share upcoming game systems, characters, and mechanics with you, providing more insight into the development process. We also aim to shape the game’s progression together with feedback from you all.
Today, we will introduce Dr. Rennor, the cyborg warrior who merges science and technology. Let's dive into his story and mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/8c8b795e0eadff6695a9b1fc9aa509d39cdf01c7.png[/img]
[h3]Who is Dr. Rennor?[/h3]
Dr. Rennor was an esteemed scientist and astronaut from Earth. Specializing in astrobiology and advanced robotics, he embarked on numerous missions to explore the depths of space, searching for signs of life and developing new technologies.

However, his fate took a drastic turn during an expedition to the planet Nyxaloria. While on his mission, his spacecraft was caught in a violent meteor storm, sustaining severe damage. All communication with Earth was lost, and the ship’s systems completely failed. Stranded in deep space, Dr. Rennor managed to survive for months on limited oxygen supplies before ultimately succumbing to the void of space.

[h3]Rebirth: Cyborg Dr. Rennor[/h3]
During one of their exploration missions, Rax and his team discovered the wreckage of Dr. Rennor’s spacecraft. Upon realizing that the body belonged to a scientist from Earth, they speculated that he might hold crucial information about Ketzeror’s plans.

With the help of Zenith Techlock’s advanced technology and the energy of Aether Streams, Dr. Rennor was revived as a cyborg. His new form granted him superhuman abilities, enhanced senses, and seamless integration with technological systems.

Initially, he struggled to accept his transformation. However, upon learning that Ketzeror’s army included creatures abducted from Earth, he resolved to fight back. Combining his scientific knowledge with his newly acquired strength, Dr. Rennor became a key player in the battle against Ketzeror’s forces.

[h3]Dr. Rennor’s Combat Abilities[/h3]

As a cyborg, Dr. Rennor was no longer just a scientist—he became a warrior. With the help of Zenith Techlock’s engineering, he now wields advanced arm attachments capable of launching powerful energy spheres at enemies.

[b]Dr. Rennor's Basic Attack[/b]
His projectiles explode upon impact, creating a secondary energy orb that rises into the air before crashing down in a random location, dealing area damage.

His long-range combat style requires strategic positioning for maximum effectiveness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/087f6ee0314423fa05310e5a11a79d7aebbb5fc5.png[/img]

[h3]Are You Ready to Build the Ultimate Cyborg Warrior?[/h3]

[b]Hello![/b]

[b]Welcome to the Ketz: Galactic Overlords devlog![/b]

Beyond regular patch notes, we want to share the new features and mechanics currently in development. We actively consider demo feedback and adjust our updates accordingly. Alongside these updates, we are also introducing new mechanics that align with our development roadmap.

This devlog aims to introduce major upcoming systems and gather your feedback. We’re excited to hear what you think! Join the discussion on Discord, Reddit, and the comments!
And now, in the very first episode of our devlog, let’s dive into Mates!

[h3]What Are Mates?[/h3]

In the Ketz universe, each Galactic Leader's society has unique developments and specializations. For example, the Rax faction excels in speed and electrical energy, while other factions focus on completely different strengths.

Throughout their daily lives—whether in war, commerce, or exploration—these societies rely on trusted companions.

Now, Galactic Leaders are offering these powerful allies to aid in the battle against Ketzeror’s rise, changing the course of war!


[b]Mates Enter the Mystimech Class![/b]

Mates are introduced as a new class of mystimechs and come in many different forms, such as:
 [list]
[*] A mystical dragon from a nature planet
[*] A floating orb infused with pure magic
[*] A high-tech combat drone
[*] Mysterious creatures from unknown realms
[/list]

With these powerful companions, you can expand your ability combinations and create Mate-focused builds to enhance your combat potential.

[b]New Features with Mates[/b]
The addition of Mates brings more strategic depth and combat power to your character. You can now specialize your build using Mate-focused stats:
[list]
[*] Mate Damage
[*] Mate Critical Chance
[*] Mate Critical Damage
[*] Mate Attack Speed
[*] Mate Cooldown
[/list]
However, since Mates are extremely valuable to Galactic Leaders, you can only summon a limited number of them per run.
But don’t worry! With the right items, you can increase this limit and complete a run with even more Mates by your side.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/7b75ee88fff4ef4185f6a9b158f1cd8383cf2ad2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Meet the Mates![/h3]
Each Mate has unique abilities and combat mechanics. Here are a few of them:

[b]Ember Drone[/b]
[list]
[*] A drone infused with the fiery powers of the Solar planet.
[*] Burns enemies from a distance without needing to engage directly.
[/list]
[b]Toxic Trail[/b]
[list]
[*] A loyal dragon companion of Lady Virelia.
[*] Due to overeating, it vomits toxic waste, poisoning nearby enemies.
[/list]
[b]Ravenous Assault[/b]
[list]
[*] Cursed ravens from the planet Tenebris.
[*] Feared creatures trained in dark magic, causing chaos on the battlefield.
[/list]
[b]Massive Foresight[/b]
[list]
[*] A mystical orb infused with the secret magic of Tenebris.
[*] Binds to enemies and curses them, weakening their abilities.
[/list]
[b]Frostbite Assault[/b]
[list]
[*] A frozen companion that leaves a trail of ice, slowing and damaging enemies.
[/list] 
[b]Bombardier Escort[/b]
[list]
[*] A bomb-carrying robot that never leaves Zenith Techlock’s side.
Now, it fights alongside you!
[/list]
[b]Laser Sentinel[/b]
[list]
[*] A drone equipped with advanced laser weaponry, developed in Technotopia.
[*] Strikes fear with its devastating laser attacks!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45247421/24876c590f188c892b9ad20e5b304056aa5c1d69.png[/img]

Share your ideas with us and help shape the evolution of this system!

Join the discussion and let us know your thoughts on Discord and Reddit!

You will be able to experience the Mate mechanics in future updates. Don’t forget to follow the patch notes!

[h3]Join the Community[/h3]

[b]Discord: https://discord.gg/YgHSTK45s7

Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/Ketz/[/b]

More exciting updates coming in the next devlog! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo HOT FIX v0.0.30
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First off, we just want to say a huge THANK YOU for all the support, feedback, and love you've shown since we launched the demo. It seriously means the world to us, and we're beyond excited to keep improving the game with your input.

Today, we’re rolling out our first update, and while it’s just the beginning, we’ve focused on fixing some of the major crash issues that you guys encountered. Stability has been our top priority, and we've put in a lot of work to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.


[b]Here’s what we’ve been working on:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed falling through dark spots on the map (yeah, it was a bit spooky).
[*] Resolved the issue where the Aether Vortex skill would break.
[*] Fixed crashes related to boss abilities.
[*] Addressed crash issues tied to boss behaviors.
[*] Fixed the problem with items not equipping properly.
[*] Removed empty items that had no descriptions.
[*] Fixed indestructible chests and their positioning.
[*] Added 'End Run' and 'Exit Game' buttons to the menu for easier navigation.
[*] Fixed targeting behavior for single-target skills to function correctly.
[/list]

This is just the first step, and we’re already working on more improvements, new content, and some exciting stuff based on your feedback.

Stay awesome,
Ketz: Galactic Overlords Team
